ED_Title: Appointment of members of the Board of the 10-Year Framework of Programmes on Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns
ED_DecisionText:
A
At its 75th plenary meeting, on 25 March 2025, the General Assembly decided that the two-year term of office of the members of the Board of the 10-Year Framework of Programmes on Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns shall begin on 25 March 2026, the date of their appointment, taking into account resolution 69/214 of 19 December 2014.

B
At its 75th plenary meeting, on 25 March 2025, the General Assembly, in accordance with resolutions 67/203 of 21 December 2012 and 69/214 of 19 December 2014 and decision 80/420 A of 25 March 2026, decided to appoint BARBADOS, FINLAND, GERMANY, HUNGARY, INDIA, MEXICO, the RUSSIAN FEDERATION and SOUTH AFRICA as members of the Board of the 10-Year Framework of Programmes on Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns for a term of office beginning on 25 March 2026 and ending on 24 March 2028.

As a result, as of 25 March 2026, the Board of the 10-Year Framework of Programmes on Sustainable Consumption and Production Patterns is composed of the following eight Member States: (footnote: Barbados, Finland, India and the Russian Federation are serving their second consecutive term. One vacancy for a member from African States and one vacancy for a member from Asia-Pacific States remain to be filled for a term of office beginning on the date of appointment and ending on 24 March 2028.) BARBADOS,* FINLAND,* GERMANY,* HUNGARY,* INDIA,* MEXICO,* RUSSIAN FEDERATION* and SOUTH AFRICA.*


__________________
* Term of office expires on 24 March 2028.
